target.title: fix(whatsapp): add chunk-idle timeout to inbound media download
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where WhatsApp inbound media downloads that stall after Baileys returns a stream (headers/start ok, then no further chunks) would block `downloadInboundMedia` forever via `saveMediaStream`'s unbounded `for await`, so inbound dispatch never produces an agent reply for that message.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Wrap the Baileys AsyncIterable with a local per-chunk idle race (production default `30_000` ms), matching Telegram's download idle floor and the LINE channel pattern (open `#86873`, different owner).
- On timeout, reject with `WhatsAppInboundMediaTimeoutError`, call `iterator.return()` so Node Readable streams are destroyed, and silence the losing `next()` to avoid `unhandledRejection`.
- Tests may pass a short `chunkTimeoutMs`; production omits it and uses the 30s floor (proven with fake timers).
- Does **not** change core `saveMediaStream` / `src/media/store.ts` (avoids competing with LINE `#86873`).
- Timeout error class stays module-private (knip unused-export gate).

No new config/env surface.

## User Impact

**Before:** A stalled WhatsApp media body could hang inbound handling for that message indefinitely.

**After:** Idle streams fail closed after 30s with a clear timeout error so the monitor loop can continue.

## Evidence

Head: `ea7699ebddd118f371256e25bdf172add2061953`

Executable negative control + fix proof:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/whatsapp/src/inbound/media.node.test.ts -- --run -t "chunk-idle|negative" --reporter=verbose
```

```text
[whatsapp media idle negative control] outcome=still-pending wait_ms=150 without_idle_wrap=true
[whatsapp media idle proof] timed_out=true elapsed_ms=53 chunkTimeoutMs=50 production_ms=30000
[whatsapp media idle proof] production_default_ms=30000 timed_out=true
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  5 passed | 11 skipped (16)
```

- **Negative control (executable):** same never-yielding AsyncIterable consumed with bare `for await` (no idle wrap) stays `still-pending` after 150ms — proves the pre-fix hang fixture.
- **After fix:** `downloadInboundMedia` with `chunkTimeoutMs: 50` rejects in ~53ms; production default advances fake timers to 30s and rejects with `chunkTimeoutMs: 30000`; `iterator.return()` called once on timeout.
- Touched: `extensions/whatsapp/src/inbound/media.ts` (+ colocated test). Sibling LINE/Telegram idle floors unchanged (different owners).

AI-assisted.
